newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed steady at 41.90 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday but dealers said strong dollar demand might push it down on Tuesday.
They said low dollar rates would soon attract major investors, putting pressure on the rupee.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate was unchanged at 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar set on October 22.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 4.85 percent, from Sunday's close at at 4.80 percent.
